title: Prescription Insurance on File — Override Share on a Corrected Claim
content:
Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, a mistaken override earns an override share on a corrected claim. The claims read are those paid on the coverage less than **1** whole month before the day the corrected claim is made, whether or not they were later reversed.

## Rule

- When such a claim carried the **vacation supply** or the **lost or stolen** override code, the charge is multiplied by **0.8**.
- When none did but such a claim carried the **therapy change** code, the charge is multiplied by **0.9**.
- Otherwise the charge is multiplied by 1.

The share multiplies the unrounded charge; the patient pay is rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Truth table (claims paid on the coverage less than 1 whole month before)

| Vacation supply or lost or stolen code present | Therapy change code present | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.8 |
| Yes | No | 0.8 |
| No | Yes | 0.9 |
| No | No | 1 |

## Boundary and scope (hypothetical, corrected claim made on 10 June)

- A lost-or-stolen claim paid on 11 May counts (less than 1 whole month); one paid on 10 May does not (1 whole month).
- A vacation-supply claim paid on 20 May and reversed on 22 May still counts.
- The claims counted are any paid on the coverage, for any prescription, not only the corrected one.
